T: Long drive to the in-laws. Dinner's ready.
D: Shrek meets Fiona's royal parents in the kingdom of Far Far Away, and it does not go well.
P: Serve the mains when Shrek and King Harold sit down at that awkward family dinner.
S: Apple wedges dipped in a hard red candy coating
Apple wedges dipped in red toffee (sugar, water and red colouring boiled to 150C), set on oiled paper, a little shiny and suspicious.
the cat in boots from Spain

Crisp fried potato cubes with smoky tomato bravas sauce and garlic aioli, alongside sizzling slices of chorizo finished with honey and parsley. Boil 800g potato cubes for 6 minutes, drain, then roast with oil and salt at 220C for 30 minutes until crisp. Simmer 1 tin crushed tomatoes with 1 crushed garlic clove, 2 tsp smoked paprika and a pinch of chilli for 15 minutes. Mix 120g mayonnaise with 1 grated garlic clove and lemon. Fry 2 sliced chorizo in a dry pan until crisp, then add 1 tbsp honey. Serve the potatoes with both sauces and the chorizo.
M: the Fairy Godmother's stop at the Friar's Fat Boy drive-thru

Double beef burgers with cheese, bacon, onion rings and a smoky sauce in soft buns, with shoestring fries, the way a fairytale drive-thru would do it. Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 2 tbsp barbecue sauce. Fry 8 rashers of bacon until crisp. Bake 800g frozen shoestring fries and 300g frozen onion rings at 220C for 20 minutes. Smash the balls thin on a smoking hot pan, salt and cook 2 minutes, flip, add cheese and cook 1 minute. Toast 4 buns and stack 2 patties, bacon, onion rings and sauce in each.

Crackling pork shoulder with roast potatoes and apple sauce
Roast pork shoulder with crackling, apple sauce and roast potatoes. Score a 2kg pork shoulder, rub with salt and roast at 230C for 30 minutes, then 170C for 2 hours.
W: Spiced gingerbread cookie cut in one giant man shape

Butter, brown sugar and golden syrup melted, flour, ginger and cinnamon mixed in, chilled, rolled and cut into one huge gingerbread man and lots of small ones, baked at 180C, iced with gumdrop buttons.
Blueberry muffins: flour, sugar, buttermilk, melted butter and egg mixed briefly, blueberries folded in, crumble on top, baked at 200C for 20 minutes.
K: Lemonade with blue raspberry cordial and edible glitter
Lemonade with a splash of blue raspberry cordial and a spoon of edible glitter swirled in, poured into little glass bottles.

note.text: Senor, I bring tidings and a hairball. The king wants dinner, and I want to be fed. Also, I am great at this job.

d.note: Pour one for Doris at the Poison Apple.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C and line a 12-hole muffin tin.
Rub the crumble flour, cold butter and brown sugar together into rough crumbs.
Mix the flour, sugar and baking powder in a large bowl.
Whisk the buttermilk, melted butter and egg, tip into the dry mix and stir only until just combined.
Fold in the blueberries, spoon into the tin and scatter with crumble.
Bake until risen and golden.
Cut the apples into thick wedges and pat very dry.
Oil a tray of baking paper.
Boil the sugar, water, golden syrup and colouring without stirring until it reaches 150C.
Dip each wedge quickly, letting the extra drip off, and set on the baking paper.
Leave to harden.

dishes.n: Far Far Away royal roast pork
dishes.make_ahead: Roast can be cooked 2 hours ahead and rested

steps.text: Heat the oven to 230C. Score the pork skin and rub well with the salt.
Roast the pork at 230C to start the crackling.
Drop the oven to 170C and keep roasting.
Toss the potatoes in oil, add to the tray and roast with the pork.
Rest the pork under foil, then carve and serve with the potatoes and apple sauce.

veg.n: Far Far Away royal stuffed roast pumpkin

ingredients.item: butternut pumpkins, halved lengthways and seeded

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Toss the potatoes in 2 tbsp of the oil and half the salt and roast for 20 minutes.
Rub the pumpkin halves with 1 tbsp of the oil and the rest of the salt and roast cut side up next to the potatoes for 35 minutes.
Fry the onion and chopped sage in the remaining oil, then mix with the breadcrumbs, walnuts and feta.
Pile the stuffing into the pumpkin hollows and roast 20 minutes more until golden and tender.
Rest for 5 minutes, then carve and serve with the potatoes and apple sauce.
Melt the butter, brown sugar and golden syrup together and let cool a little.
Stir in the flour, ginger, cinnamon and bicarbonate of soda to make a dough.
Wrap and chill the dough for an hour.
Heat the oven to 180C. Roll out and cut one huge gingerbread man and lots of small ones.
Bake the small ones first, then the big one, until firm at the edges.
Cool, mix the icing sugar with a little water, pipe on and add gumdrop buttons.

dishes.make_ahead: Nothing to do ahead; pour the lemonade and cordial just before serving so it stays fizzy

steps.text: Pour the lemonade into small bottles or tall glasses.
Add a splash of cordial to each and stir gently.
Drop in a pinch of glitter, give one more swirl and serve straight away.

s.note: Apple wedges dipped in a hard red candy coating
s.how: Cut 4 apples into thick wedges and pat dry. Boil 300g sugar, 100ml water, a spoon of golden syrup and red colouring to 150C. Dip each wedge quickly and set on oiled baking paper. Leave to harden for 10 minutes and serve the same day.

m.n: Far Far Away royal roast pork
m.note: Crackling pork shoulder with roast potatoes and apple sauce
m.how: Score a 2kg pork shoulder, rub with salt and roast at 230C for 30 minutes, then 170C for 2 hours. Roast 1kg potatoes for the last hour. Serve with 200g apple sauce.

w.note: Spiced gingerbread cookie cut in one giant man shape
w.how: Melt 125g butter, 100g brown sugar and 120ml golden syrup together. Stir in 375g flour, 2 tsp ginger and a pinch of cinnamon. Chill for an hour, roll out and cut one huge gingerbread man and lots of small ones. Bake at 180C for 12 minutes, then ice with gumdrop buttons.

Mix 300g flour, 150g sugar and 2 tsp baking powder. Add 250ml buttermilk, 100g melted butter and an egg and stir only until just combined. Fold in 200g blueberries, spoon into a lined muffin tin, scatter with crumble and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

d.note: Lemonade with blue raspberry cordial and edible glitter
d.how: Pour cold lemonade into small glass bottles or tall glasses. Add a splash of blue raspberry cordial to each and stir gently. Drop in a small pinch of edible glitter and give it one more swirl so it shimmers as it settles. Serve straight away.
